description_en: Binds an edge application to an edge instance
description_zh: 绑定边缘应用到边缘实例
kebab_example: aliyun iot bind-application-to-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id Tb4r9k3GWHJFWv000000 --application-id 361368ba5a094da9bf5625d092000000 --application-version 3.7 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindApplicationToEdgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the edge application. On the Application Management page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target application name to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 边缘应用的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的应用管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the edge application
parameters.name: application_version
